footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to PG&E: includes a $280M income tax benefit, $2.6B from preferred dividends; after $2.7B attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 2.1% to $24.9B in 2025. Gross margin was 85.1%, versus 85.9% a year earlier, and operating income rose 6.5% to $4.7B, a 19.0% margin.
Net income rose 4.8% to $2.6B, or $1.18 per share. Operating cash flow was $8.7B and free cash flow −$3.1B, versus −$2.3B.
sources: PG&E Corporation Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
